'''Vulptereens''' were a barrel-shaped [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with shovel-like [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]].

==Biology and appearance==
Vulptereens had six tusks protruding outward from their snouts, a feeler on their snout, and two pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]] on top. Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were yellow-green, with black pupils capable of seeing in dark conditions, yet they lacked good depth perception. This resulted in the use of echolocation in these conditions.

The [[Species/Legends|species]]' two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] ended in clawed hands, that if [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismembered]] could result in aphasia since they lacked a central brain. However, they were quite hardy when exposed to a variety of environments and did not succumb to toxic conditions.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

==History==
[[File:Vulptereen_Dud_Bolt.png|thumb|left|140px|[[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]] was a fairly well-known Vulptereen]]
The Vulptereen were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]], a world that once contained a thriving ecosystem. The Vulptereen, however, transformed their verdant [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] into a wasteland due to their over-industrialization.<ref name="CSWE" />

Sometime between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the Vulptereens were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and joined the rest of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

However, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] seized control of Vulpter around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], which allowed the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] to exploit the Vulptereens. They forced them to drill tunnels that could be used as storage for the Trade Federation, and dumped the products that they could not sell on the planet.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Vulptereen in the galaxy==
Vulptereens were known to be [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], such as [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]], a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
At one point, [[Randy Stradley]], a writer for [[Dark Horse Comics]], wanted to create a Vulptereen Jedi. However, he was told that "they're not smart enough to be Jedi."<ref name="DH">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?t=7257&postdays=0&postorder=asc&start=15|thread=Shouldn't there be a Wookiee Jedi?|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|time=14:37}}</ref>
